about_the_game:
"Escape the Cursed Cave" is a suspense puzzle visual novel, with core gameplay centered on "story choices + clue reasoning" as detailed below:

  • Core Mechanics: Players progress through the story by reading immersive text, triggering branch choices at key nodes (e.g., "Trust the mysterious NPC" "Explore the secret room alone"), while collecting hidden clues (diary fragments, item descriptions, environmental details) to unlock different plot directions.

  • Player Objective: In the dangerous and unknown cursed cave, uncover the truth behind the curse through rational choices and clue integration, help the protagonist escape danger, and achieve various endings (including perfect escape, truth revelation, tragic sacrifice, etc.).

  • Controls: Left-click to advance text and select options; shortcut keys to open the clue backpack and plot rewind function. Auto-play and text speed adjustment are available to adapt to different reading habits.

  • Gameplay Highlights: Features 3 main story branches and 8 hidden endings. Clue collection progress affects plot unlocking, and some key choices require reasoning based on collected clues, combining the immersion of visual novels with the interactivity of puzzle-solving.
